requirements.requirement: The system must render a prescription behavior module within MessageBubble when prescription behavior data is present in the provider scorecard payload.
The system must display a relevance indicator (e.g., high/medium/low or equivalent visual encoding) based on transformed prescription data.
The system must visually distinguish integrity status as either clean or flagged using a clear UI indicator.
The system must render a list of top relevant drugs derived from the transformed prescription behavior data.
The system must limit the displayed top drugs list to the maximum count defined in the frontend data contract.
The system must display the prescription behavior contribution to the overall provider score as a numeric or visual component.
The system must integrate the prescription behavior module into the existing scorecard layout without breaking rendering of other modules.
The system must render the module consistently across all MessageBubble instances that include provider evaluation responses.
The system must not render the prescription behavior module when prescription data is absent or null in the payload.
The system must display a fallback UI state indicating unavailable prescription data when the module is expected but required fields are missing.
The system must handle malformed prescription behavior data without causing MessageBubble rendering failure.
The system must apply consistent styling conventions with other scorecard modules (spacing, typography, color system).
The system must ensure the prescription behavior module renders within acceptable performance thresholds (no perceptible delay beyond existing MessageBubble render time).
The system must support re-rendering of the prescription behavior module when new chat messages update the provider scorecard.
